geography.mapRule: Three inhabited regions exist in the same world but begin outside each other's verified knowledge.
geography.firstContactRule: Countries cannot learn of another country until exploration/communication ranges overlap through simulation.

observerRules: The observer sees the full world state.
Each country agent receives only information that country could know.
No scripted war, alliance, discovery, disaster or crossover.
Crossovers occur only when simulation state satisfies contact conditions.
The author does not override policy decisions for narrative convenience.
